# Fluvie 0.3.1

Flutter widgets become reproducible video. Canonical documentation is generated from the same versioned source as the CLI and MCP bundle.

## Start here

- [AI authoring entry page](https://fluvie.dev/for-ai): prompt template, quick or guided workflow, and direct links for assistants.
- [Portable Fluvie video skill](https://fluvie.dev/skills/fluvie-video/SKILL.md): end-to-end workflow for a new or existing project; MCP is optional.
- [AI video authoring guide](https://docs.fluvie.dev/guides/ai-video-authoring/): choose direct creation or approval checkpoints.
- [Create a video from local assets](https://docs.fluvie.dev/getting-started/authoring-with-assets/): project setup, asset inspection, preview, and MP4 output.
- Local agents: run `fluvie docs --context` for version-matched offline guidance.
- [Offline complete documentation](https://docs.fluvie.dev/llms-full.txt): use when a focused page is not enough.
